NOTE: -- Pro forma results reflect the completion of the Company's initial public offering, the issuance of $100 million of senior subordinated notes, the sale/leaseback of 11 hotels with Hospitality Properties Trust and the application of all proceeds therefrom as if such transactions had occurred at the beginning of each period.

-- Excluding the effect of expenses associated with the Company's pending merger with Patriot American Hospitality, Inc., the Company's effective tax rate for the quarter ended June 30, 1997 was 39.5%.

-- Excluding one-time merger-related expenses of $2.7 million, associated with Wyndham's pending merger agreement with Patriot American Hospitality, EBITDA increased 50 percent to $9.0 million for pro forma Q2 of 1996 to $13.5 million in Q2 of 1997.
-- Pro forma figures reflect company's completion of an ipo of 4,197,500 shares on May 21, 1996 and completion of severl related transactions.
